text:
maya: Heads-up: planning runtime roll v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 during nightly window 2026-06-23 02:00 UTC. This touches API header routing and console read-model migration. Need quick cross-service preflight + pin/rollback rules. deploy-bot will run staged canary unless objections.

drew: Window works for me. Please drop rollback criteria so we align on thresholds.

maya: Proposed rollback: >5% error-rate delta (5m rolling) OR p95 latency +200ms (10m) OR any 500s from model init path. Canary soak 15m per stage.

alex: API needs a pin to runtime:v2.3.1 for 24h post-flip. Console requires migration runbook for index rename. Jen, is migration idempotent?

jen: Migration is idempotent; ran on staging. Caveat: toggle `console.use_new_index` must be enabled only after full runtime flip or dashboards break. Backout is toggle=false + dry-run revert.

pranav: Router: header routing change is additive. I'll add a shim to map old header `x-rw-route` to new names for 48h post-roll.

maya: Action items: alex -> place pin in config; jen -> migration runbook + toggle timeline; prana v-> router shim; drew/sre -> finalize SLO + pager thresholds. deploy-bot: await ack to schedule.

deploy-bot: To schedule: `deploy-bot schedule --service runtime --version v2.4.0 --window 2026-06-23T02:00Z --canary-stages 1,5,25,100 --soak 15m`

alex: Draft pin config in `routes.yaml`:
```
- service: api
  pin: runtime:v2.3.1
  on_full_flip: runtime:v2.4.0
  grace_period: 24h
```
Opening PR now.

jen: Migration runbook PR: https://git.internal/rw/console/migrations/pulls/42 9 includes toggle timeline and backout steps.

sre-oncall: SRE plan: monitor 5m error-rate and p95 latency. Pager if error-rate >10% over baseline OR absolute p95 >300ms. If pager fires, immediate rollback. Can we enable deploy-bot auto-rollback on pager?

maya: Yes. deploy-bot, can you enable auto-rollback on pager for runtime,api,router?

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback supported. Command: `deploy-bot configure --auto-rollback on-pager --services runtime,api,router --window 2026-06-23T02:00Z` 9 confirm to enable.

pranav: Confirmed. Router shim PR: https://git.internal/rw/router/pulls/211 9 tests for fallback header mapping included.

drew: Will console show per-route canary splits for telemetry comparison? Need per-route error deltas.

alex: Yes, we emit `route.variant` metric tag during canary. I'll add dashboard links to the release note.

jen: Fast rollback for migration: toggle `console.use_new_index=false` + `console:migrate revert --dry-run` then scale down readers to drain. Documented in PR.

maya: Great. I'll draft release notes once PRs are up. Keep night-team looped: @sre-oncall @pranav @alex @jen

sre-oncall: I'll own on-call for the window and will post an incident channel when we start. Add runbook link to deploy ticket.

alex: Pin PR: https://git.internal/rw/api/config/pulls/88 9 includes rollback snippet `routes rollback --service api --to runtime:v2.3.1`.

maya: All PRs linked, actions assigned. If no objections by EOD UTC, I'll schedule and enable auto-rollback hook.

drew: No objections. :thumbsup: 

pranav: Router side OK.

jen: Ack. I'll be on-call 30m after flip for migration rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: runtime v2.4.0 canary for 2026-06-23T02:00Z. Stages 1%,5%,25%,100%. Auto-rollback on-pager enabled for runtime,api,router. Ticket: #DEP-2431

maya: Thanks all. Pinning this thread to the ticket and we'll follow the runbook during the window.
